The hydrant is approximately 109 px tall. Using the acceleration-derived scale and correcting to its 12.565 m distance gives 1.01 m.
The streetlight spans approximately 446 px vertically. Applying the acceleration-derived scale with its 12.325 m distance gives 4.04 m.
The person spans approximately 171 px from head to soles. Correcting the acceleration-derived scale to the person's distance gives 1.73 m.
The green car moves approximately 2800 px/s near 1.0 s. Applying the acceleration-derived scale at its 4.630 m distance gives 9.5 m/s.
The orange car spans approximately 618 px bumper to bumper. Its tracked pixel acceleration is approximately 373 px/s², giving 130 px/m from the known 2.86 m/s² acceleration.
The orange car is approximately 204 px tall; dividing by its acceleration-derived scale of approximately 130 px/m gives 1.56 m.
The curb face is approximately 28 px tall. Using the acceleration-derived scale and the nearby streetlight's depth as an approximation for the curb gives 0.25 m.
